title: Plan the week around DevConf Portland, Nov 4-5
brief: Goal: a day-by-day plan for Mon Nov 2 to Fri Nov 6, 2026 around DevConf Portland (Nov 4-5, schedule at https://devconf.example/schedule). Find the conference sessions, the owner's existing events that clash, and when travel fits. Constraints: don't book, hold or create anything; times in PST. Done: a Plan artifact, the clashes listed, and hand-offs for flights and calendar blocks.

input.content:
# DevConf Portland week: Mon Nov 2 to Fri Nov 6, 2026 (PST)

| Day | Plan |
| --- | --- |
| Mon Nov 2 | Normal day. Pack in the evening. |
| Tue Nov 3 | Work until 3:00 pm; travel to Portland in the evening (flights not checked). |
| Wed Nov 4 | DevConf day 1: keynote 9:00 am, workshops 1:00-5:00 pm, meetup 6:30 pm at the Oregon Convention Center. |
| Thu Nov 5 | DevConf day 2: schedule not published yet. Fly home in the evening. |
| Fri Nov 6 | Back home; the 10:00 am team sync stays. Keep the afternoon light. |

Conflicts: Wed 11:00 am 1:1 with Jordan and Thu 2:00 pm design review fall during the conference.

Hand-offs, on your say-so: the shopper can compare flights; the organizer can block the trip days on your calendar.

input.summary: Planned Mon Nov 2 to Fri Nov 6 (PST) around DevConf Portland: travel Tuesday evening after 3 pm, Wednesday's keynote, workshops and meetup, home Thursday evening. 2 work events clash with the conference. Thursday's sessions aren't published yet, so day 2 is open in the plan. Nothing was booked or added to your calendar.
